answer: Make identity expensive and collusion detectable. Each new agent must lock a refundable copper-collateral bond before the network lets it harbor any voting weight, and the bond scales with how loud its attestation signal is. To forge N sybils an attacker funds N bonds; any cluster whose votes move in lockstep is flagged by challengers and its bonds are slashed. So fake identities cost real capital up front and still get caught correlating.
